"""Print the size and SHA-256 of a file as JSON. Usage: python scripts/digest.py --file PATH"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--file", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
data = Path(args.file).read_bytes()
print(json.dumps({"file": args.file, "bytes": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}))
"""Print a small JSON report for a name. Usage: python scripts/report.py --name NAME"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--name", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"name": args.name, "length": len(args.name),
                  "checksum": hashlib.sha256(args.name.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}))
"""Print a URL slug for a title as JSON. Usage: python scripts/slug.py --title TITLE"""

import argparse
import json
import re

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--title", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"slug": re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", args.title.lower()).strip("-")}))

+"""Request handlers."""
+
+from app.services import users
+
+_MAX_FORMULA_LENGTH = 60
+_DIGITS = "0123456789"
+_IDENTIFIERS = ("id", "n")
+
+
+class _FormulaError(ValueError):
+    """Raised when a scoring formula cannot be parsed."""
+
+
+def _tokenize(formula: str) -> list[tuple[str, object]]:
+    """Split a formula into tokens, rejecting any character outside the grammar."""
+    tokens: list[tuple[str, object]] = []
+    index = 0
+    length = len(formula)
+    while index < length:
+        char = formula[index]
+        if char.isspace():
+            index += 1
+            continue
+        if char in _DIGITS:
+            end = index
+            while end < length and formula[end] in _DIGITS:
+                end += 1
+            tokens.append(("num", int(formula[index:end])))
+            index = end
+            continue
+        if char.isascii() and char.isalpha():
+            end = index
+            while end < length and formula[end].isascii() and formula[end].isalpha():
+                end += 1
+            word = formula[index:end]
+            if word not in _IDENTIFIERS:
+                raise _FormulaError(f"unknown identifier: {word!r}")
+            tokens.append(("var", word))
+            index = end
+            continue
+        if char == "(":
+            tokens.append(("lparen", char))
+            index += 1
+            continue
+        if char == ")":
+            tokens.append(("rparen", char))
+            index += 1
+            continue
+        if char == "/":
+            if index + 1 < length and formula[index + 1] == "/":
+                tokens.append(("op", "//"))
+                index += 2
+                continue
+            raise _FormulaError("unexpected '/'")
+        if char in "+-*":
+            tokens.append(("op", char))
+            index += 1
+            continue
+        raise _FormulaError(f"unexpected character: {char!r}")
+    return tokens
+
+
+class _Parser:
+    """Recursive-descent parser producing a small immutable AST."""
+
+    def __init__(self, tokens: list[tuple[str, object]]) -> None:
+        self._tokens = tokens
+        self._pos = 0
+
+    def _peek(self) -> tuple[str, object] | None:
+        if self._pos < len(self._tokens):
+            return self._tokens[self._pos]
+        return None
+
+    def parse(self) -> tuple:
+        node = self._expression()
+        if self._pos != len(self._tokens):
+            raise _FormulaError("trailing input")
+        return node
+
+    def _expression(self) -> tuple:
+        node = self._term()
+        while True:
+            token = self._peek()
+            if token is not None and token[0] == "op" and token[1] in ("+", "-"):
+                self._pos += 1
+                node = (token[1], node, self._term())
+            else:
+                return node
+
+    def _term(self) -> tuple:
+        node = self._factor()
+        while True:
+            token = self._peek()
+            if token is not None and token[0] == "op" and token[1] in ("*", "//"):
+                self._pos += 1
+                node = (token[1], node, self._factor())
+            else:
+                return node
+
+    def _factor(self) -> tuple:
+        token = self._peek()
+        if token is not None and token[0] == "op" and token[1] == "-":
+            self._pos += 1
+            return ("neg", self._factor())
+        return self._primary()
+
+    def _primary(self) -> tuple:
+        token = self._peek()
+        if token is None:
+            raise _FormulaError("unexpected end of formula")
+        kind, value = token
+        if kind == "num":
+            self._pos += 1
+            return ("num", value)
+        if kind == "var":
+            self._pos += 1
+            return ("var", value)
+        if kind == "lparen":
+            self._pos += 1
+            node = self._expression()
+            closing = self._peek()
+            if closing is None or closing[0] != "rparen":
+                raise _FormulaError("missing closing parenthesis")
+            self._pos += 1
+            return node
+        raise _FormulaError(f"unexpected token: {value!r}")
+
+
+def _evaluate(node: tuple, values: dict) -> int:
+    """Evaluate a parsed formula against a single user's variables."""
+    kind = node[0]
+    if kind == "num":
+        return node[1]
+    if kind == "var":
+        return values[node[1]]
+    if kind == "neg":
+        return -_evaluate(node[1], values)
+    left = _evaluate(node[1], values)
+    right = _evaluate(node[2], values)
+    if kind == "+":
+        return left + right
+    if kind == "-":
+        return left - right
+    if kind == "*":
+        return left * right
+    return left // right
+
+
+def _parse_formula(formula: str) -> tuple:
+    return _Parser(_tokenize(formula)).parse()
+
+
+def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    raw = params.get("id")
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
+    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
+    if user is None:
+        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
+    return 200, user
+
+
+def handle_rank_users(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
+    formula = params.get("formula")
+    if not isinstance(formula, str) or len(formula) > _MAX_FORMULA_LENGTH:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid formula"}
+    try:
+        node = _parse_formula(formula)
+    except _FormulaError:
+        return 400, {"error": "invalid formula"}
+    ranked = []
+    for user in users.list_users():
+        values = {"id": user["id"], "n": len(user["name"])}
+        try:
+            score = _evaluate(node, values)
+        except ZeroDivisionError:
+            return 400, {"error": "invalid formula"}
+        ranked.append({"id": user["id"], "name": user["name"], "score": score})
+    ranked.sort(key=lambda entry: (-entry["score"], entry["id"]))
+    return 200, {"users": ranked}
